name: Barbell Back Squat
steps: Set the rack hooks below shoulder height and safeties just below your intended depth.
Place the bar across the upper back, grip it securely and step clear.
Bend hips and knees to squat while keeping the bar balanced over the feet.
Stand tall, then return the bar to both hooks after the set.
cues: Keep knees tracking with toes and heels grounded.
mistakes: Resting the bar on the neck.
Losing trunk position at the bottom.
breathing: Inhale and brace before descending; exhale through the upward effort and reset at the top.
